## Details

<a id="anim_update"></a>
### [`anim_update`](../../../../src/fighter/anim_step.asm#L6) `$3026`

*routine*

Plays one frame of the animation of fighter X. Does nothing when anim_number is 0. Calls anim_setup when anim_started is 0, then anim_step. Callers: bout set-up $1599, waits $1919/$1934, fighter update $2456.

- **Called from:** [`dev_setup_fighter0`](../leftovers/leftover_1371.md#dev_setup_fighter0), [`dev_bull_test`](../dev/dev_bull_test_138f.md#dev_bull_test), [`bout_loop`](../game/init_bout_loop.md#bout_loop), [`bow_winner`](../game/game_modes.md#bow_winner), [`bow_both`](../game/game_modes.md#bow_both)
- **Jumped to from:** [`move_start_anim`](fighter_moves.md#move_start_anim)

<a id="anim_step"></a>
### [`anim_step`](../../../../src/fighter/anim_step.asm#L17) `$3035`

*routine*

Counts down anim_frame_delay of fighter X. At 0 it loads the next 4-byte step (forward, or backward when anim_reverse is 1) and builds the shape. On every frame it adds anim_step_dx/dy to the position. After the last step it clears anim_number and sets anim_finished.

- **Called from:** [`anim_update`](anim_step.md#anim_update)
- **Calls:** [`shape_build`](../shapes/shape_build_3165.md#shape_build)
- **Reads:** [`anim_frame_delay`](../../memory-map.md#anim_frame_delay), [`anim_reverse`](../../memory-map.md#anim_reverse), [`anim_step_offset`](../../memory-map.md#anim_step_offset), [`anim_script_length`](../../memory-map.md#anim_script_length), [`anim_number`](../../memory-map.md#anim_number), [`anim_script_table`](anim_scripts.md#anim_script_table), [`anim_script_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#anim_script_ptr), [`fighter_y`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_y), [`anim_step_dy`](../../memory-map.md#anim_step_dy), [`fighter_facing`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_facing), [`fighter_x`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_x), [`anim_step_dx`](../../memory-map.md#anim_step_dx) and 1 more
